rateLimitFromCode: functions/api/mcp.js enforces MCP_RATE_LIMIT = 20 requests per MCP_RATE_WINDOW_MS = 60000 ms per client IP (KV backed checkRateLimit, key prefix mcp). Over the limit the HTTP status is 429, the JSON RPC error code is -32000 with message "Rate limit exceeded", and the response carries Retry-After: 30. If the rate limit store itself throws, the endpoint falls back to a bounded in memory limiter (checkRateLimitMemoryOnly) at the same numbers rather than failing open or closed. Unchanged at build d339606. Not retested live in this round: the earlier same day probes already confirmed the 429 shape, and the probe budget is itself rate limited.
resultAnatomyFromCode: A successful tools/call result carries content (one text block), structuredContent shaped by the tool's declared outputSchema, and isError false, as observed live above. The search text block is the answer followed by a numbered source list and, when a Search record was stored, its address; when the upstream search failed or timed out, the same envelope ships with isError true and a plain language failure text (and no structuredContent on the error path).
